authored: This file declares the SHAPE of a format and the surprises a reader has to survive. It contains nothing taken from anybody's file. Sample files are generated from it by scripts/generate-intake-fixture.mjs, and their content is invented.
literalUse: FORMAT DISCRIMINATOR. The entry name, class names and property names below are the tokens a reader must match to locate anything in a serialised object graph; they are the same ones the adapter carries. No template name, section name, item name or rating word from any real file appears in this repository.

quirks.statement: The rating vocabulary is defined by whoever authored the template. Vocabularies of three, four and five entries were observed, sharing no words.
The rating vocabulary may be absent entirely, and that is common rather than exceptional.
A vocabulary entry may carry leading or trailing whitespace that is part of the value.
A boolean property may be absent rather than false, and absence is the common case.
The document may carry no version, and the versions carried by those that do span many years.
The archive may hold anything alongside the structure entry; entry counts from single digits to dozens were observed.
A template may declare no sections and no items at all, and such a file is legitimate.
